svg.title: Step 7 mockup 16 · A mini tournament for any game: start, sign up, the draw, the match card, report (player)
svg.text: 16 · A mini tournament for any game: start, sign up, the draw, the match card, report (player)
Use case: a player starts a Demo Squad cup in the evening; others sign up solo, balanced teams are drawn, and the players run their own matches

g.text: Teams of 3 · 2 to 4 teams a game
and 5 more · teams are drawn at 21:00
First in line for the next one
Best of one · the winner plays
Drag the teams into their places
A different order goes to the crew
Kept on the event's champions page

svg.text: Any member starts one for a game whose rules are set in the catalogue; the rules shown come from it (M1, M2).
Formats as cards with a small drawing; the core builds the chosen one for the count at the start (M5, D18).
Solo sign-up by default; the core's team builder draws even teams from ratings (M3, M4).
Players left over are listed, first in line for the next one, as in the Finals app (M3).
Any player of the game sets the lobby code; only that game's players see it (M7).
Both teams report; the same order decides, a different one or a report waiting 10 minutes goes to the crew (M8, M9).
No season points; the champion and rating change stay in the mini tournament (M4, M10).
Drawn in the hub's frame and the platform's look; the Finals app itself is not redrawn (0030).
